Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: descriptive set theory | ID: 31059

Result

Every complex spectrum f: X -> Y between Banach space spaces is uniformly continuous on compact subsets.

Step 1. By the projective spectral theorem, we decompose \(Q_{01330011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the projective spectral family.

Step 2. By the parabolic spectral theorem, we decompose \(Q_{01330012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the parabolic spectral family.

Step 3. Applying the semisimple interpolation theorem to \(Q_{01330013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via variational interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
